title: buceras angustifolium
intro: Buceras angustifolium, commonly known as the "Santa María" or "Santa Maria", is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to provide relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Buceras angustifolium include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body, making it an effective natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and medicinal properties.
